quest.title: Urgent Repairs
quest.description: Magar is transporting goods to Springvale, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will do.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Great. You do that, and I'll— I'll, uh, keep watch.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Ugh, trust me to find a way to balls everything up...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: If I can't even take a cart of wine from A to B without running into trouble... What good am I for anything?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: I'll be fired from the Winery if I don't get my act together... That is, if Mr. Connor isn't on to me already. Ugh, I bet Mr. Elzer's drafting up my dismissal letter as I speak... It's hopeless, it's all hope—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa Nelly! Calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, even if my job situation is beyond hope, I should still get this cart to its destination.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: The cart's also been damaged... Traveler, could I trouble you to help me find what I need? Just one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Plank</color> will be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright. Don't you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Phew... Thanks. Meanwhile, I'll... have a— a think about how to fix the cart.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: That'll do the trick. I should be able to fix the cart now. I think. I hope...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Shoot, they're back! Help me, Traveler!

talks.objective: Give the Sturdy Plank to Magar

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Take a look in the woods over there for me, would you? If you find a <color=#00E1FFFF>rope</color>, bring it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. That will do nicely.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: This should hold out long enough to get me to Springvale. Once I've dropped off the goods there, I'll head back to the winery and update them on what went down.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Hopefully Elzer doesn't fire me on the spot when he sees what's happened to his cart...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: You should be able to find a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Plank</color> in the forest. Bring it to me when you find one, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank goodness you are here, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: But I don't know how I'm going to fix my cart now, after that.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: There's damage everywhere... I guess I'll have to patch it up as best I can. Whatever I do, it's not going to be a permanent fix.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Never mind. As long as it holds together for the journey into town, I can figure out the next step once I'm there.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: I thought there was some rope in the cart... Gah, they must have made off with it.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Traveler... Why don't you take a look in the woods over there for me? If there's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Rope</color> around, that would be perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I have to go...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Don't go... Please. If I try, I—I'll only mess it up again. I need you. You're my only hope.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No can do.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Magar
dialogues.text: Uh... But you're the only one around here who can help me, so... Thanks in advance...!
